Name: Whiskey Forge - PIF
Author: electroslime
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Hello![/b][/size][size=5][size=6][b]
[/b][/size][/size][size=2]
This mod adds a dungeon-esque room that can be turned into whatever you'd like.
It works for both cabins and farmhouse.

[/size][size=4][b][u]Recolours[/u][/b][/size][size=2]

Whiskey Forge comes with it's own texture so no need for additional re-colours


[/size][size=4][b][u]How to Download[/u][/b]
[/size][size=2]1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]Personal Rooms[/url]﻿
2. Download Rar.
3. Extract into mods folder. [/size][size=4]
[/size][size=2]4. Please refer to PIF's instructions for dimension door information[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=2]

I know there could be a few minor bugs I still have to fix so I'll get to it when i can.[/size]

New dungeon ALT currently in the making for those that like bigger spaces. [/center]
